patreon._note: Reader support via Patreon. Paste the page URL (e.g. https://www.patreon.com/waynesvillenews) to turn on the support links in the footer, on /supporters/, under each brief, and in the email edition. Leave empty to hide them all. Patrons get no say in coverage.

businessSupport._note: Business supporter tier, advertised on /supporters/ and the directory. price is shown as written. url: the join link for the tier (e.g. the Patreon tier checkout link); if empty, the Patreon page URL above is used. Joining doesn't add a business automatically: add it to src/data/supporters.json.
